notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for the empty FOM module vector boundary of Create Federation Execution with MIM. The source uses only the standard C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, base FOM, valid MIM, endpoint, logical-time selection, and callback configuration. It verifies that an empty FOM request is rejected with the standard InvalidFOM exception without reserving the federation name and that a later valid FOM/MIM create, join, lookup, resign, destroy, and disconnect lifecycle succeeds without asserting provider-specific names, registries, headers, or implementation behavior.
